newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via $2.0 billion customer RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via $2.0 billion customer RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added reserves to the banking system via a round of $2.0 billion of customer repurchase agreements Tuesday morning.

As expected, the Fed entered the banking system earlier than its normal 1130 EST/1630 GMT intervention period due to the abbreviated Christmas Eve trading session. The market was scheduled to close at 1400 EST/1900 GMT.
Fed funds were trading right at the Fed's target rate of 5-1/4 percent following the intervention, the same level they have traded at all session.
-- John P. Hughes, N.A. Treasury Desk, 212-859-1663
